scope: Chrome desktop and touch viewport emulation of the real local App. Layout/preview exposes controlled legal temporary skills; confirmation tests use natural beginner expedition. No remote multiplayer rooms; not physical Safari/iPad hardware.

hand.testHarnessNote: The first touch-end check ran while momentum scrolling remained active. Follow-up waited 500ms after touchend and compared current max/left; all three affected sizes reach the final card.

selection.scope: Natural beginner expedition, real AI and combat; no injected player state or clock overrides.

checks: Warm yellow pixel paper, ink names/costs and folded page edges remain readable in both category and skill views.
Four category colours and finishes remain present; affordable ultimate flames rise in screen-up direction, following both resting rotation and hover/focus transforms.
Each of 6 and 10 attack cards is checked for hover/focus clipping and real details-button activation at all five sizes; 80 details interactions total.
Touch contexts use taps and actual swipe input. Coarse-pointer skills retain fan angles with wider spacing so details buttons stay exposed.
Board/table rectangles remain unchanged across categories, temporary skill count changes, hover/focus and locked-card states.

Natural expedition verifies staged selection, persistent lifting after pointer departure, same-card cancellation, Cancel/Escape, unaffordable blocking, details preserving selection and two actual confirmed rounds. No action frames or committed moves appear before confirmation.
Energy/disabled/free/locked/dead flame gating, no horizontal page overflow and both app/OS reduced-motion are verified.
fixedDuringQA: Transparent outer slot hitboxes intercepted an adjacent info button on tablet. Outer slots now ignore pointer input; real card faces receive it. Coarse pointers receive 8px skill gaps while desktop keeps an overlapping fan.

animation.method: Normal CSS/canvas playback with actual mouse hover, selection, cancellation and confirmed combat; approximately 100ms samples. No fake clock or image redrawing.
